semanticLimits: Infundibulum of neurohypophysis is not assumed to be the whole pituitary stalk or pars tuberalis.
Anterior/posterior pituitary classes are not promoted to complete whole-gland, capsule or lesion/gland separations.
Tuberal hypothalamic regional names do not establish a separately labelled tuber cinereum, median eminence or validated nuclei.
A third-ventricular lumen label does not independently resolve the ventricular floor tissues or infundibular recess.
Contact between source-labelled optic parts does not establish fibre crossings, physiological continuity, visual function or normal variation.
Source binary cell faces are not the complete obtained tissue interfaces requested by the reporting contract.
This source-selection map does not erase the separate publication cases, BodyParts3D objects or any other existing module evidence.
No disease, enhancement curve, vascular patency, histological identity, neural function or current-patient registration is inferred.
